description: A dangerous and deceptive creature that appears as a harmless patch of sandy terrain. When approached, it reveals its true nature by dragging unsuspecting victims into its shifting, suffocating depths. The Quicksand Pool is a semi-sentient elemental entity formed by corrupted earth magic, thriving in desolate areas such as deserts and swamps.

traits.name: Engulf
traits.description: A creature that steps into the quicksand must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained and pulled 5 feet deeper into the pool. The creature takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage at the start of its turn while restrained.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the Quicksand Pool remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary patch of sand.

actions.name: Suffocating Pull
actions.description: The Quicksand Pool attempts to pull a creature deeper into its depths. The target must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet deeper and take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, the creature is only pulled 5 feet.

actions.name: Whirlpool
actions.description: The Quicksand Pool can create a vortex of swirling sand around itself. All creatures within a 15-foot radius must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 5 feet towards the center of the pool and take 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
